title: Can I post an image of the RTP here on the forum to ask someone to make an edit for my game in RPG Maker XP ?

posts.author: NaMosca
posts.body: Can I post an image of the RTP here on the forum to ask someone to make an edit for my game in RPG Maker XP?

posts.author: Kes
posts.body:
Yes.
Though when you say
an image of the RTP
Click to expand...
I assume you don't mean the whole RTP, but an item from it.

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Yep, long as you do it in the correct channel then editing the RPT is allowed.
but as Kes said, maybe be more specific on what parts of the RTP you want edited.
